## 1. Learning objectives

- Read data with SELECT / FROM / LIMIT and sort with ORDER BY
- Filter with =, <, IN, LIKE and IS NULL, and explain why `= NULL` never matches
- Summarize with COUNT / AVG / ROUND and GROUP BY at the right grain
- Answer multi-table questions with nested subqueries and with JOINs through a junction table

## 6. Common mistakes

- **C0.1**: `SELECT *` on a 400k-row table; forgetting the semicolon in the shell
- **C0.2**: `= NULL` instead of `IS NULL`; expecting `=` to be case-insensitive
- **C0.3**: assuming tables have an inherent order
- **C0.4**: selecting a non-grouped column; forgetting that GROUP BY on text is case-sensitive
- **C0.5**: `=` when the subquery returns several rows (SQLite silently uses the first)
- **C0.6**: joining on the wrong columns → duplicate or empty results
